shortDescription: Remote system operations on a PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: data_connection_type
options.description: Type of data connection from the local system to the remote system. C(iSCSI) - iSCSI connection type. C(FC) - Fibre Channel connection type. Fibre Channel (FC) connection type requires properly configured FC fabric and zoning between the PowerStore systems as a prerequisite. The module cannot configure FC fabric. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system. It was added in PowerStore version 4.4.

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the remote system. To remove the description empty string is to be passed.

options.name: fc_target_wwns
options.description: List of target Fibre Channel World Wide Names (WWNs) of the remote system for FC data connection. This parameter is applicable ONLY when I(type) is C(Universal) and I(data_connection_type) is C(FC). For PowerStore-to-PowerStore FC connections, FC targets are auto-discovered and this parameter should not be used. The WWN format is a colon-separated hexadecimal string, e.g., C(58:cc:f0:98:49:21:07:02). It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system. It was added in PowerStore versio

options.name: network_latency
options.description: Replication traffic can be tuned for higher efficiency depending on the expected network latency. Setting to low will have latency of less than five milliseconds. Setting to high will have latency of more than five milliseconds.

options.name: new_remote_address
options.description: New management IP of the remote system.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: remote_address
options.description: Management IP of the remote system. Parameter I(remote_id) and I(remote_address) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: remote_id
options.description: ID of the remote system. ID for the remote system is autogenerated, cannot be passed during creation of a remote system. Parameter I(remote_id) and I(remote_address) are mutually exclusive.

options.name: remote_name
options.description: Name of the remote system. Parameter I(remote_name) cannot be mentioned during addition of a new remote system.

options.name: remote_password
options.description: Password used in basic authentication to remote PowerStore cluster. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system.

options.name: remote_port
options.description: Remote system's port number. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system.

options.name: remote_temp_user_id
options.description: Temporary user ID used for certificate-based authentication to the remote PowerStore cluster. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system. Parameter I(remote_temp_user_id) and I(remote_temp_user_secret) are required together and mutually exclusive with I(remote_user) and I(remote_password).

options.name: remote_temp_user_secret
options.description: Temporary secret used for certificate-based authentication to the remote PowerStore cluster. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system. Parameter I(remote_temp_user_id) and I(remote_temp_user_secret) are required together and mutually exclusive with I(remote_user) and I(remote_password).

options.name: remote_user
options.description: Username used in basic authentication to remote PowerStore cluster. It can be mentioned only during creation of the remote system.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the remote system after the task is performed. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For all Create, Modify or Get details operations it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: type
options.description: Remote system type. If not specified, the system auto-detects PowerStore clusters. For Universal-type FC connections, this must be set to C(Universal). It was added in PowerStore version 4.0.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.

options.name: wait_for_completion
options.description: Flag to indicate if the operation should be run synchronously or asynchronously. C(true) signifies synchronous execution. By default, modify and delete operation will run asynchronously.
